items.author: mikhail-yablakau
items.body:
**Title:** MCP Server returns fact_embedding arrays causing 50x token inflation

**Bug Description:**
Graphiti MCP server started returning `fact_embedding` arrays (1536 float values) in `search_memory_facts` responses, causing massive token inflation from ~5K to 250K+ tokens per request.

**Expected Behavior:**
- search_memory_facts should return only fact metadata without embeddings
- Worked correctly ~2-3 weeks ago

**Current Behavior:**
- Every fact includes `attributes.fact_embedding` with 1536 float values
- Single query with 3 facts = 250K+ tokens

**Impact:**
- Production cost increase
items.title: MCP Server returns fact_embedding arrays causing 50x token inflation
